Hinweise: Same form factor as the TL-WR710N.
Powered from AC electric wall-socket, so the USB port delivers 5V, 1A and can power and charge a device.
openwrt_wiki.Installation Beware: ath79 Image for the TL-WR810N v1.1 (EU) is currently broken and will result in a soft-bricked device. Use the ar71xx image instead! ... Update: OpenWRT 19.07.7 ath79 now does not result in a boot-loop on this device, but USB will not provide power. Snapshots from 27.2.2021 onward have USB-power-issue fixed, 21.02-rc2 should also have it fixed (commit 62099d98e4746d8a4e9ee79360314c1900c8974e).

Hardware Details.System-On-Chip: Qualcomm Atheros QCA9531-BL3A (US 1.0, EU 1.1) | Qualcomm Atheros QCA9533-BL3A (2.0)

Hardware Details.Control Elements: Reset button (US 1.0) | Reset button, operation mode switch (EU 1.1, 2.0)

openwrt_wiki.Opening the Case: Start by inserting a pry tool above the ethernet connectors. Lift the lid, work in counterclockwise direction. Don't be afraid to apply quite some force, in particular at the corners of the case.
openwrt_wiki.Removing the PCB: Remove the light pipe above the LED (melted with the case) ... remove the dots of ductile glue that hold the PCB to the case ... start lifting the PCB out at the edge opposite to the ethernet connectors.

Serial.TP_TX1: TX - Reaches only a maximum of ~2.5V because of pull-down resistor R64.
Serial.TP_RX1: RX - This test point is not directly connected to the SoC, next to it is an unpopulated jumper (R107) that needs to be closed.
Serial.Text: Board voltage is 3.3V. The parameters of the serial console are 115200 8N1. To access the U-Boot prompt, type tpl quickly when the bootloader is about to autoboot.

Operation Mode Switch.Text: GPIO 1 and GPIO 0 are mapped to the key codes BTN_0 and BTN_1

openwrt_image_mk.Device/tplink_tl-wr810n-v1:
define Device/tplink_tl-wr810n-v1
  $(Device/tplink-8mlzma)
  SOC := qca9531
  DEVICE_MODEL := TL-WR810N
  DEVICE_VARIANT := v1
  TPLINK_HWID := 0x8100001
  DEVICE_PACKAGES := kmod-usb2 kmod-usb-ledtrig-usbport
  SUPPORTED_DEVICES += tl-wr810n
endef
